## Meridian Technologies — FY2024 financial analysis

**FY2024 revenue was $637.6 million.** Revenue rose through Q3 before declining 3.4% quarter over quarter in Q4. Gross margin also fell in Q4, while operating expenses continued to increase, putting pressure on operating profitability.

| Metric | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | FY2024 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Revenue ($m) | 142.3 | 158.7 | 171.2 | 165.4 | **637.6** |
| Gross margin | 34.2% | 35.8% | 36.1% | 33.9% | **35.0%** |
| Gross profit ($m, calculated) | 48.7 | 56.8 | 61.8 | 56.1 | **223.4** |
| Operating expenses ($m) | 38.4 | 41.2 | 48.7 | 52.3 | **180.6** |
| Gross profit less operating expenses ($m) | 10.3 | 15.6 | 13.1 | 3.8 | **42.8** |

*FY gross margin is calculated from total gross profit divided by total revenue. Figures are rounded.*

### Key takeaways

- **Growth slowed late in the year.** Revenue increased 11.5% in Q2 and 7.9% in Q3, then fell 3.4% in Q4. Q4 revenue was still 16.2% above Q1, but the data does not support a year-over-year growth comparison.
- **Q4 profitability tightened sharply.** Gross margin declined from 36.1% in Q3 to 33.9% in Q4. At the same time, operating expenses rose by $3.6 million, reducing gross profit less operating expenses from $13.1 million to $3.8 million.
- **Costs grew faster than revenue across the period.** From Q1 to Q4, revenue increased 16.2%, while operating expenses increased 36.2%. Operating expenses rose from 27.0% to 31.6% of revenue.
- **Headcount expansion warrants attention.** Q4 headcount of 1,240 was 350 higher than Q1, a 39.3% increase. The figures do not establish how much of the expense increase was attributable to hiring, but the expansion makes productivity and cost discipline important areas to assess.

**Overall:** Meridian generated positive gross profit less operating expenses in every quarter, but Q4 showed a marked deterioration in that measure.
